map.name: Great Watersheds
map.description: Mountain-fed rivers, inland lakes and generous valley country. Seed watersheds-v3:candidate-2. Civ V assigns multiplayer starts.

identity.label: Great Watersheds
identity.premise: A few dominant mountain-fed river systems organize settlement, floodplains and regional identity.
identity.blindRecognition: The world is arranged around a few enormous river systems.

matchAssessment.summary: This non-Polis report measures final starts, resources, city-state access, production and territorial capacity; it does not pretend the world was constructed as a strategic graph.

evidence: Nearest rival capitals average 42.5 hexes apart.
100% of starts can reach a strategic resource within five hexes.
Starts average 29.5 productive grassland or hill tiles within five hexes.
100% of starts have a local luxury.
Capital spacing provides 42.5 hexes of average defensive and trade context.
80% mean city-state contestability measures whether minor powers are shared rather than private.
Each major has roughly 624 land tiles of world capacity.

limitations: Capital route redundancy and front width are available only when Polis retains a strategic graph.
Human and AI counts describe lobby composition; fixed civilization seats require Scenario authoring.
